coverageFinding: Registered skills cover context, source evidence, bounded documentation, design intent and visual comparison, but none alone guarantees claim-led long-form technical narrative or paged-media PDF integrity.

taskLocalCapabilities.purpose: Turn a bounded claim packet into continuous technical prose organized by reader question, thesis, causal explanation, worked trace, failure path and transition.
requiredChecks: heading removal does not destroy the argument
causal sequences are prose or diagrams rather than disconnected feature lists
each chapter hands an explicit value or question to the next chapter

taskLocalCapabilities.purpose: Move between human problem, system principle, project mechanism and operational consequence so the explanation transfers beyond one keyword set.
requiredChecks: framework names are examples rather than the thesis
the section returns from abstraction to a project trace
the reader can name a transferable principle

taskLocalCapabilities.purpose: Select Systems Monograph or Evidence Notebook from the information function of the content, not from alternating decoration.
requiredChecks: lists and callouts do not replace the argument

taskLocalCapabilities.purpose: Render A4 HTML/CSS into a selectable-text PDF while preserving typography, vectors, links and page boundaries.
Measure page count, extractable text, page geometry, overflow and asset digests without accepting the content.
Use page previews and contact sheets to detect slide-like emptiness, repeated cards, abrupt mode changes and unreadable density.
taskLocalCapabilities.limitation: Does not substitute for an independent visual validator.

tools.purpose: Read exact local source, study artifacts and registered profiles without mutation.
Retrieve official MDN, React and Anthropic background sources with URL provenance.
Produce original visual direction boards; never use generated small text as factual content.
Render live-text A4 PDF and per-page previews from frozen HTML/CSS.
Check each page element for horizontal and vertical overflow.
Count PDF pages and extractable text per page.
Bind source, visual, PDF and handoff evidence to exact immutable bytes.
Expose cross-page rhythm and visual repetition for review.

gates.requirement: A manuscript unit passes the seven-element narrative contract before page styling.
A section explains the human problem and system principle before using framework or API names as project examples.
Reject a page whose meaning lives mainly in keywords, badges or three-or-more independent boxes.
Observed facts, external background and project inference remain separately labeled.
Expected pages, selectable text, zero page overflow and exact digests are present.
Fact and visual acceptance remains pending until an author-independent validator reviews frozen inputs.
